inlines.v: GENEALOG'ICAL, adjective [from genealogy.] 1. Pertaining to the descent of persons or families; exhibiting the succession of families from a progenitor; as a genealogical table. 2. According to the descent of a person or family from an ancestor; as genealogical order.
